import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    L = int(data[2])
    R = int(data[3])

    mod = 998244353
    total = R - L + 1
    # count of even numbers in [L, R]
    E = total // 2 + (1 if (R & 1) == 0 and (L & 1) == 0 else 0)
    O = total - E

    nm = N * M
    if nm & 1:
        ans = pow(E + O, nm, mod)
    else:
        ans = (pow(E + O, nm, mod) + pow(E - O, nm, mod)) % mod
        ans = (ans * pow(2, mod - 2, mod)) % mod

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
